data.headline: Beverage shelf stocking, stock rotation and store rounds
data.summary: They stock beverages in stores, rotate products by date, remove expired bottles and place orders through a phone app. They drive between stores during daily rounds.

signals.rendering: They stock shelves with beer and soft drinks in stores for a brewery.
They drive between stores to complete daily shelf-stocking rounds.
They check product dates, move older bottles forward and remove expired products.
They count missing products and place stock orders through a phone app.
They prefer working independently without constant supervision.
